reviews.comment: honestly don't know why she has a bad review. Personally I loved her. The tests are tough, but not that bad if you just go to class. I thought her lectures were really interesting and she had us do fun game/experiment stuff in class that applied really well to what we were learning. I'm a chronic class skipper and she made me want to go to class.

Fully open ended tests, often requiring paragraph responses and fully multi step worked out equations where you are expected to memorize formulas for. The TA does NOT give partial credit for your open ended responses so if you arent correct you are basically screwed. Would never take this professor if I could go back in time.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Eckel was okay, depending on the topic her lectures could be interesting or boring, exams usually include something from the problem set and discussions regarding the experiments she covered in class (make sure you know how to explain the experiments and their results). She also had her TAs give a few lectures which were not great.

We had occasional pop quizzes and some exam questions were based on what we discussed in class so you risk missing a test question if you skip a lot. Lots of fun and interesting discussions and she relates all of her lessons with real-life examples. 2 writing assignments based on a podcast/article/book, 2 exams, various mini assignments.

This was Eckel's 1st time teaching Personnel but it was pretty bad. The content was interesting, but she changed the grading criteria half way through the semester. The midterm was terrible but she heard us out and gave us an open note final that we got to submit questions for. 2 tests, 2 reading responses, chapter quizzes and completion grades
